description: Write-time envelope validator for .soc-recommendations. Enforces the mutation_intent contract defined in soc-simulation/schemas/mutation_intent.schema.json and recommendation.schema.json. For rule-update mutations, also enforces rule_patch.schema.json — prose-only patches are rejected. Docs that violate the contract are rerouted to .soc-dead-letter with the validation errors attached, so the producer workflow is immediately debuggable. In envelope-validator-v4 the pipeline also admits informational analyst-facing types (capability_gap, rule_tuning, rule_authoring) with minimal validation — they land in .soc-recommendations for the Autonomy Feed UI but are ignored by soc_autonomous_applier because it filters by `type=mutation_intent`.

set.description: Ensure @timestamp exists so DLQ rows are queryable even for producers that forgot it.

script.description: Normalize type-drifted fields that break ES object mappings. expected_impact must be a Map — coerce scalar/string values to an empty map so the doc lands in .soc-recommendations instead of crashing the writer workflow.

Collect every envelope violation into ctx._envelope_errors. Full envelope validation is applied only to type=mutation_intent docs. Informational analyst-facing types (capability_gap, rule_tuning, rule_authoring) get minimal validation so they can flow to the UI without being applied by the governance pipeline.
For invalid docs: rebuild ctx as a DLQ row (original_doc + structured error fields). Runs only when validation flagged errors.

Auto-stamp final_status=no_action for valid docs that carry no actionable payload. Agent findings reports (source=soc_deteng-agent, soc-signal-quality-agent, soc_gap_analyzer) often land here without a patch/new_definition when the agent correctly decided 'nothing to act on this cycle'. Without this processor they accumulate as untagged 'pending' forever. ALSO mirrors details.action='no_action' so downstream recommendation filters correctly hide them from the 'pending' count. Only runs when envelope validation passed AND producer did not set final_status itself.

reroute.description: Send invalid docs to .soc-dead-letter. Triggered when the validation script populated validation_errors. Note: the reroute processor is terminal, so this must be the last visible processor.
